title: 04 · Service overview · Sounding
strengths: Reads as a real on-call screen: the alert statement ('p95 latency above its 450 ms objective since 13:21 UTC · View alert') sits beside the service title, and the deploy that caused it (v2.41.0 at 13:12) is marked on every chart and named in the meta line

Quiet chart grammar from the study: 1.5 px ink lines, previous day dashed, last hour dotted, hatched no-trace-data band, end-only axis labels, 'Updated 14:02 UTC', a sampling footnote and one honest empty card ('No upstream timeouts in this range')

Numbers agree: 11 endpoint rows add up to 18,375,270 requests (18.38M, 213 req/s) and 41,604 errors (0.23%); the request and error series are scaled to those totals and the trace gap shows in latency, errors and every sparkline but not in load-balancer requests
One amber only for the alerting series and the words that point to it; near-black primary; 400/500/600; 36 px rows; mono only on routes, versions and latencies
slop_signals: Every chart feature at once: pinned tooltip, objective line, hatched no-data band, deploy diamonds, dotted partial hour and an 'Alerting' badge; it reads as a feature tour more than a page in use
The latency chart's lower grey line (p50) is not in the legend
Four bordered chart cards; Vercel and Stripe keep widget chrome lighter
fixes: Unpin the tooltip in the main frame or show it in a second state
Label the p50 line in the latency card or drop it
Rename the workspace 'Wrenfield Pay' (Fennick has Wrenfield Water Co.) and the signed-in user 'Mara Okafor' (same full name in styles/01 and app-screens/09)

references.what: Environment select, time range, chart cards with chevron titles, empty card 'No invocations in this time range', table below; ours follows it with richer data
p90/p50 in mono per card and honest 'Not enough data to display a trend'
Average tier: bar colors per status class, crowded axes; ours is quieter

fixed: One temporary state per frame: the pinned tooltip and crosshair moved to shot-tooltip.png (?state=tooltip)
Tooltip change is computed from the figures shown: 228/s vs 214/s reads +6.5%
The p50 line is labelled in the legend ('Latency p50')
'Go 1.23' (out of support by Oct 2026) is now 'Go 1.26'
Names: Wrenfield Pay (W) → Fulmar Pay (F); Mara Okafor (MO) → Yusuf Hartmann (YH)
